title: Use a policy mixture only on the same actual record law
statement: Chronological selector probabilities cancel the common causal environment under the SAME conditional initial law, even with latent path memory. Finite-grid uniform confidence plus rounding and optimization error licenses the selected policy. It does not give a posterior guarantee for every bank or permit hidden-state reuse, a leaked private mixture key, or an unrelated post-data optimizer.

requires: Known finite-state/contextual controller class and action alphabet, warranted complete conditional records and common causal plant
Fixed/hard episode budget and bounded terminal score; actual conditional initial-law preparation
Fresh private selector randomness and qualified timing/implementation when deploying exact rational policies
provides: Chronological selector probabilities cancel the common causal environment under the SAME conditional initial law, even with latent path memory. Finite-grid uniform confidence plus rounding and optimization error licenses the selected policy. It does not give a posterior guarantee for every bank or permit hidden-state reuse, a leaked private mixture key, or an unrelated post-data optimizer.
assumptions: The same conditional initial-law/plant kernels, supplied controller contexts and private-key exclusion are required. Last hidden state is not a fresh deployment start. Episode count is not total physical preparation, mixing, waiting or sensing cost. The fixed finite-gap family cannot be reused for every arbitrarily small accuracy; expected-stopping alternatives do not inherit a bound under every law. Broad universal-coding novelty was withdrawn. Finite executed diagnostics and the strong ordinary likelihood-ratio/DAC comparisons establish no device or advantage.
costs: Finite-grid optimization, all exploration and rare weighted records, acquisition/storage/reset/waiting and deployment calls
Complexity grows with actual controller dimension and horizon/domination constant; no free start/mixing interface
contract.units: Dimensionless probabilities/Bell loss/half-diamond error as explicitly stated; source calls, resets, memory and control gates are separate costs.
